summary: Read an entire file synchronously while preserving Node Buffer/string, encoding, descriptor-position, and error behavior.

requirements.options_shape: statically known or represented by NodeFsOptions

semantics.return_value: Buffer when encoding is null/omitted; string when encoding is specified
semantics.file_descriptor: if path is an fd, reading starts at its current position and does not auto-close it
semantics.encoding: Node Buffer encodings, not arbitrary .NET Encoding defaults

caveats: Reading a directory is platform-specific in Node; do not normalize it to one cross-platform result.
A direct File.ReadAllText changes the default return type from Buffer to string.
WHATWG file: URLs and Buffer paths require Node path normalization.

tests.name: default returns bytes
tests.expected_behavior: returns a Node-compatible Buffer containing the exact file bytes

tests.name: utf8 returns string
tests.input: const s = fs.readFileSync('a.txt', 'utf8'); console.log(typeof s, s);
tests.expected_behavior: returns a string decoded with Node's utf8 semantics; invalid byte sequences use Node-compatible replacement behavior
